title: Create src/lib/backends/copilot.ts — Copilot CLI backend
description: Implement the AgentBackend interface for GitHub Copilot CLI. The backend spawns the copilot command with autopilot mode and the prompt. Validates that the copilot binary is available in PATH.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/backends/copilot.ts exists and exports a CopilotBackend implementing AgentBackend
spawn() runs 'copilot --autopilot --prompt <prompt>' via child_process.spawn with stdio:pipe
parseOutput() returns text lines as { type: 'text', content: line }
Missing copilot binary throws a descriptive error before spawning

steps.details: Create the file. Import spawn from child_process, which from 'which' (or use execSync('which copilot') to check). Import AgentBackend, BackendOptions, ParsedOutput from types.ts.

Before spawning, check if 'copilot' is in PATH: `try { execSync('which copilot', { stdio: 'ignore' }) } catch { throw new Error('copilot CLI not found in PATH. Install it from https://github.com/github/gh-copilot') }`

spawn(prompt: string, options: BackendOptions): ChildProcess { // check binary first; return spawn('copilot', ['--autopilot', '--prompt', prompt], { cwd: options.cwd || process.cwd(), stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }) }
parseOutput(line: string): ParsedOutput | null { if (!line.trim()) return null; return { type: 'text', content: line } }
Create and export a singleton: export const copilotBackend: AgentBackend = { name: 'Copilot CLI', spawn, parseOutput }

technicalNotes: The prompt is passed as a separate array element to spawn() to prevent shell injection
Use stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] to capture stdout/stderr while ignoring stdin
